description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), record a new customer receipt (payment received). Navigate to the Receipts module and click 'New Receipt'. Fill in the form as follows: Date: today. In the 'Paid By' section, select Contact: Alfreds Futterkiste (existing customer). In the 'Received In' section, select Account: Cash on Hand (the cash account seeded in the system). In the line items row, enter Amount: 440.00 (leave Account as the default or select Suspense). Save the receipt. Credentials: Username = administrator, Password = (leave empty).
